instance_name.description: Unique identifier for this Daphne instance; used in process titles and logs.

bind_hosts.description: IP addresses or hostnames to bind the server to (e.g., ['0.0.0.0', '::1']).

unix_socket_path.description: Unix socket path to bind to (alternative to host/port; use with caution in multi-process setups).

asgi_application.description: Python dotted-path to the ASGI application callable (e.g., 'myapp.asgi:application').

num_workers.description: Number of worker processes. Increase for CPU-bound workloads (typically CPU cores + 1).

num_threads.description: Number of threads per worker. Set >1 only if your application is I/O-bound.

log_file.description: Path to write error logs; leave empty to log to stderr/stdout.

serve_static.description: Enable serving static files directly from Daphne (NOT recommended for production—use a dedicated web server instead).

static_mappings.description: Static file mount points: list of URL path prefix → filesystem directory mappings.

path.description: URL path prefix for static files (e.g., '/static/')

health_check_path.description: HTTP GET endpoint path to use for health checks (e.g., '/health/' for load balancers).

worker_timeout.description: Seconds before Daphne kills an unresponsive worker.

websocket_timeout.description: Idle timeout (seconds) for WebSocket connections; 0 means no timeout.

websocket_max_queue.description: Maximum number of queued WebSocket messages per connection; 0 = default (100).

process_name.description: Process name prefix shown in `ps` output (e.g., 'myapp-daphne').

environment_variables.description: Environment variables passed to worker processes.

access_log.description: Path for HTTP access logs; '-' logs to stdout.

user.description: Run as this system user (requires privileges to switch).

daemon.description: Run Daphne as a background daemon process.

pid_file.description: Path to PID file (required when daemon=true).
